description: Parse JavaScript whose very first line carries a flow type-checker pragma, written either as a single-line comment pragma or a block comment pragma at the start of the file, followed by code that is not valid plain JavaScript. The unsupported flow dialect causes parsing to abort with an empty program and exactly one diagnostic announcing the unsupported dialect. The leading pragma is itself counted among the extracted comments, its kind reflecting whether it was written as a single-line or block comment.
